# Nova — Sprint 5 Competitor Benchmark: Dashboard + Calendar Deep Polish

**Sprint:** 5 (Dashboard + Calendar)
**Target surfaces:** `/dashboard` and `/calendar`
**Date:** 2026-04-17
**For:** Vega (spec) → Koda (implementation)

---

## Part 1 — Dashboard Benchmark

### 1. Linear (Home / Inbox)
- **KPI row:** No fixed KPI row on home — Linear uses Dashboards (separate surface). Dashboards expose a flexible grid of widget cards (2–4 per row, widget-sized); sparklines are thin (1px stroke, ~24px tall), rendered inline under the metric number. Delta is right-aligned as `+12.4%` with a small arrow glyph (▲ green / ▼ red), no background pill.
- **Up Next / Today:** Inbox (`G I`) is the "today" surface — grouped notifications by type (Assigned, Mentions, Subscribed). Each row = avatar (32px) + issue title + metadata tail (team · state · time).
- **Activity feed:** Rendered as grouped rows, not cards. Avatar at left, one-line action ("Alice changed status to In Progress · 2h"), hover reveals preview pane.
- **Quick actions:** Global `C` = new issue from anywhere. Command palette `Cmd+K`. No "button strip" — all actions are keyboard-first. Visible hint: small kbd chip `C` appears on the "New issue" button.
- **Alerts / inbox zero:** Inbox row fades to 40% opacity on `E` (archive) with a 250ms transition; "Inbox Zero" empty state shows a centered illustration + "You're all caught up".
- **Empty state:** Soft illustration + one CTA ("Create your first issue") + a link to docs. No fake data.

**Source:** [Linear Docs — Inbox](https://linear.app/docs/inbox) · [Linear Dashboards](https://linear.app/docs/dashboards) · [Linear Keyboard Shortcuts](https://keycombiner.com/collections/linear/)

### 2. Stripe Dashboard (Home)
- **KPI row:** 4 cards across: Gross volume, Net volume, New customers, Successful payments. Each card = label (12px medium grey) + big number (28px semibold) + `% change` tail (green/red, small arrow) + inline sparkline (full-width card bottom, 40px tall, 1.5px stroke, subtle gradient fill at 8% opacity).
- **Up Next:** "Your overview" section below KPIs — a chronological list of recent payments, disputes, failed charges.
- **Activity feed:** "Recent payments" table — 5 rows, each row = amount · customer · status pill · timestamp. Live-updating via polling.
- **Quick actions:** Top-right `+ Create` dropdown (payment, invoice, customer, product). Global `/` for search-as-command.
- **Alerts:** Yellow banner at top of Home for action items ("Verify your identity", "2 disputes need response"). Dismissible with `×`.
- **Empty state:** New account shows "Start accepting payments" checklist (4 steps with progress ring). No fake KPIs — literal zeros with muted "No data yet" chips.

**Source:** [Stripe Dashboard Home Charts](https://support.stripe.com/questions/dashboard-home-page-charts-for-business-insights) · [Stripe Empty State Pattern](https://docs.stripe.com/stripe-apps/patterns/empty-state) · [Stripe Web Dashboard](https://docs.stripe.com/dashboard/basics)

### 3. Vercel Dashboard (Overview)
- **KPI row:** Minimal — Vercel's overview is project-list-centric, not KPI-centric. Project cards each carry a tiny deployment chart (Bandwidth / Requests / Errors as 40px sparklines, 1px stroke, no fill).
- **Up Next:** "Recent deployments" — inline rows with status dot (green/yellow/red pulsing), branch name, commit SHA, relative timestamp.
- **Activity feed:** Per-project deployment log; filterable by branch + author.
- **Quick actions:** Top-right `Add New...` dropdown (Project / Team / Domain). Collapsible sidebar with `[` to toggle.
- **Alerts:** Inline red banner per project if build failing; otherwise none.
- **Empty state:** Single centered CTA "Deploy your first project" with template grid below.

**Source:** [The New Side of Vercel](https://vercel.com/try/new-dashboard) · [Vercel Dashboard UX Analysis](https://medium.com/design-bootcamp/vercels-new-dashboard-ux-what-it-teaches-us-about-developer-centric-design-93117215fe31)

### 4. Cron / Notion Calendar (Home Agenda)
- **KPI row:** None — Notion Calendar is agenda-first, no metrics.
- **Up Next widget:** "Today" section pinned top of sidebar — current meeting highlighted with a colored left-border (4px, matches calendar color). Next meeting shows countdown ("in 23m"). Below: full day agenda as a vertical rail of time blocks.
- **Activity feed:** None (calendar app).
- **Quick actions:** Cmd+K for command menu. `C` to create event. Natural language parsing in create field ("lunch with jen 1pm thurs").
- **Alerts:** Join button appears 5m before meeting with a pulse animation. Notification badge on tab.
- **Empty state:** "No events today" + subtle illustration.

**Source:** [Notion Calendar](https://www.notion.com/product/calendar) · [Cron is now Notion Calendar](https://cronhq.notion.site/Cron-Calendar-5625be54feac4e13a75b10271b65ddb7)

### 5. Superhuman (Inbox)
- **KPI row:** None (inbox app). Count in top-left: `Inbox 23`.
- **Up Next:** Split pane — list left (40%), reader right (60%). "Read later" and "Split Inbox" surface important conversations.
- **Activity feed:** Not applicable — it's an inbox.
- **Quick actions:** `Cmd+K` command palette with action hints that teach shortcuts (the action you want shows `E` or `H` on the right so you learn it). `E` = done, `H` = remind me, `C` = compose.
- **Alerts:** Snooze/reminder expiry brings email back — subtle top-banner toast.
- **Empty state:** "Inbox Zero" illustration (waves, calm) with motivational message — becomes a reward loop.

**Source:** [Superhuman Keyboard Shortcuts](https://download.superhuman.com/Superhuman%20Keyboard%20Shortcuts.pdf) · [Speed Up With Shortcuts](https://help.superhuman.com/hc/en-us/articles/45191759067411-Speed-Up-With-Shortcuts) · [Inbox Zero in 7 Steps](https://blog.superhuman.com/inbox-zero-in-7-steps/)

---

## Part 2 — Calendar Benchmark

### 1. Cal.com (Week view)
- **Day/Week/Month toggle:** Segmented control top-right (`Day | Week | Month`). Active = filled pill, inactive = ghost. Keyboard: `1/2/3` for view switch.
- **Event rendering:** Event block = rounded 8px corner, left-border 3px in event-type color, label + time stacked. Overlapping events split horizontally via a greedy column-packing algorithm; each overlap group renders as its own CSS grid (from Cal3ndar.gg analysis). Time-grid horizontal lines = 1px, 4% opacity. Half-hour lines = dashed.
- **Drag-to-reschedule:** Ghost preview at new position (70% opacity), original stays at 30% until drop. Snap to 15-min grid.
- **Click-empty-slot:** Opens quick-create popover anchored to click point with time pre-filled.
- **Mobile:** Day view default <768px, horizontal swipe to next/prev day with momentum.
- **Keyboard:** Cal.com relies on button nav primarily; week navigation via arrow keys on focused day.
- **Load performance:** Cal.com renders events via windowed rendering — only visible day-columns; production-grade forks (Cal3ndar.gg) use virtualization + just-in-time data fetching to handle thousands of events without DOM bloat.

**Source:** [Cal.com Event Types Guide](https://cal.com/blog/event-types-guide-calcom) · [Cal.com Color Customization](https://cal.com/blog/transform-your-booking-page-with-cal-com-s-customizable-colors) · [Building a Virtualized Calendar (Cal3ndar.gg)](https://medium.com/@ayoub.alfurjani/building-a-production-grade-virtualized-calendar-the-tech-behind-cal3ndar-gg-d4dc3fddc6b4)

### 2. Fantastical
- **Day/Week/Month:** `⌘1` Day, `⌘2` Week, `⌘3` Month, also Quarter + Year views. Toggle in toolbar + menu bar.
- **Event rendering:** Rounded blocks with left color-bar per calendar source. Overlap: columns split equally; tooltip reveals hidden details.
- **Drag-to-reschedule:** Option-drag duplicates. Multi-day drag in week view creates repeating event.
- **Click-empty-slot:** Natural language parser inline ("Dinner w/ Sara Fri 7pm") → event created.
- **Mobile:** Compact day list + week scrubber at top. Pinch to zoom time-grid density.
- **Keyboard:** Arrow keys move day/week. `Option+→` jumps month in Month view. `T` = today.
- **Load:** Native app (macOS/iOS) — uses system EventKit caching.

**Source:** [Fantastical for Mac — Keyboard Shortcuts](https://flexibits.com/fantastical/help/keyboard-shortcuts) · [Fantastical — Calendar Views](https://flexibits.com/fantastical/help/calendar-views) · [Using Keyboard Shortcuts in Fantastical](https://flexibits.com/blog/2023/01/a-day-in-the-life-of-using-keyboard-shortcuts-in-fantastical/)

### 3. Google Calendar
- **Day/Week/Month:** `D` Day, `W` Week, `M` Month, `Y` Year, `A` Agenda. Dropdown + keyboard.
- **Event rendering:** Solid-fill blocks, calendar color-coded. Overlapping = side-by-side columns within the hour band. Time-grid lines 1px at ~6% opacity. Half-hour tick = shorter 4px dash at left margin.
- **Drag-to-reschedule:** Real-time move; resize handle on bottom edge. Snap to 15-min.
- **Click-empty-slot:** Click = quick-add popover; click+drag = precise range pre-fill.
- **Mobile:** Agenda view on phones, week view scrolls horizontally day-by-day. Swipe up/down = date scrub.
- **Keyboard:** `T` = today, `J/N` next, `K/P` previous, `G` = go-to-date, `?` = help, `C` = create.
- **Load:** Aggressive pagination + month-window fetch.

**Source:** [Google Calendar Keyboard Shortcuts](https://support.google.com/calendar/answer/37034?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop) · [Google Calendar Shortcuts Complete List](https://www.usecarly.com/blog/google-calendar-keyboard-shortcuts/)

### 4. Motion
- **Day/Week/Month:** Day + Week default; Month less emphasized (AI-scheduled tasks live best in day/week).
- **Event rendering:** Color-coded per project. Tasks vs events distinguished by border: **dotted border = flexible/free task** (AI may reschedule), **solid border = locked task**. Blocked time = diagonal grey shading.
- **Drag-to-reschedule:** Drag locks task to that time (overrides AI). Ghost preview at drop target.
- **Click-empty-slot:** Opens task-or-event picker.
- **Mobile:** Day view default with AI-priority list below.
- **Keyboard:** Less comprehensive than Linear/Fantastical; primarily mouse.
- **Load:** Proprietary — AI recompute on drop.

**Source:** [Motion Auto-scheduling](https://www.usemotion.com/help/time-management/auto-scheduling) · [Motion Review — Intelligent Calendar](https://readcaffeine.com/motion-review/) · [Motion App Review](https://upbase.io/blog/motion-app-review/)

### 5. Superhuman Calendar
- **Day/Week/Month:** Week default on desktop, Day on mobile.
- **Event rendering:** Minimal — thin border + label, no heavy fill. Overlaps handled via columns.
- **Drag-to-reschedule:** Present; visual similar to Cron (ghost preview).
- **Click-empty-slot:** Inline quick-add with natural language.
- **Mobile:** Agenda-first.
- **Keyboard:** Inherits Superhuman's full shortcut discipline (`Cmd+K` palette; `E` done; `H` remind).
- **Load:** Client-side virtualization over synced Gmail/Google data.

**Source:** [Superhuman Desktop Shortcuts](https://help.superhuman.com/hc/en-us/articles/43658258433299-Desktop-Shortcuts)

### Calendar performance synthesis (500+ events)
- Render only visible day-columns (Week = 7; Day = 1).
- Virtualize event rows within a column when event count > 50 per day.

- **D/W/M:** `⌘1` Day, `⌘2` Week, `⌘3` Month (also Quarter, Year).
- **Event rendering:** Rounded block, left color-bar per source. Overlap = equal-width columns + tooltip for hidden detail.
- **Drag-to-reschedule:** Option-drag duplicates. Week-view multi-day drag = repeating event.
- **Click-empty-slot:** Natural-language parser inline.
- **Mobile:** Day list + top week scrubber. Pinch zooms grid density.
- **Keyboard:** Arrows = nav. `Option+→` jumps month. `T` = today.
- **Load:** Native — EventKit caching.

Source: [Fantastical Mac Shortcuts](https://flexibits.com/fantastical/help/keyboard-shortcuts) · [Calendar Views](https://flexibits.com/fantastical/help/calendar-views)

### 3. Google Calendar
- **D/W/M:** `D`/`W`/`M`/`Y`/`A` (agenda).
- **Event rendering:** Solid fill, calendar-color coded. Overlaps = side-by-side columns within hour band. Time-grid 1px at ~6% opacity; half-hour = 4px dash at left margin.
- **Drag-to-reschedule:** Real-time; bottom-edge resize handle. Snap to 15-min.
- **Click-empty-slot:** Click = popover; click+drag = precise range pre-fill.
- **Mobile:** Agenda default on phone; week scrolls horizontally. Swipe = date scrub.
- **Keyboard:** `T` today, `J/N` next, `K/P` prev, `G` go-to-date, `?` help, `C` create.
- **Load:** Pagination + month-window fetch.

Source: [Google Calendar Shortcuts](https://support.google.com/calendar/answer/37034) · [Complete List](https://www.usecarly.com/blog/google-calendar-keyboard-shortcuts/)

### 4. Motion
- **D/W/M:** Day + Week default; Month de-emphasized.
- **Event rendering:** Color per project. **Dotted border = flexible task** (AI may reschedule); **solid border = locked**. Blocked time = diagonal grey shading.
- **Drag-to-reschedule:** Drag locks to time. Ghost preview at drop.
- **Click-empty-slot:** Task-or-event picker.
- **Mobile:** Day view + AI priority list.
- **Keyboard:** Less comprehensive — mouse-first.
- **Load:** AI recompute on drop.

Source: [Motion Auto-scheduling](https://www.usemotion.com/help/time-management/auto-scheduling) · [Motion Review](https://readcaffeine.com/motion-review/)

### 5. Superhuman Calendar
- **D/W/M:** Week desktop, Day mobile.
- **Event rendering:** Minimal — thin border + label, no heavy fill. Column overlaps.
- **Drag-to-reschedule:** Cron-style ghost preview.
- **Click-empty-slot:** Inline natural-language quick-add.
- **Mobile:** Agenda-first.
- **Keyboard:** Superhuman discipline — `Cmd+K`, `E`, `H`.
- **Load:** Client virtualization over synced Google data.

Source: [Superhuman Desktop Shortcuts](https://help.superhuman.com/hc/en-us/articles/43658258433299-Desktop-Shortcuts)

### Performance (500+ events)
- Render only visible day-columns (Week=7, Day=1).
- Virtualize rows within a column when > 50 events/day.
- Greedy column-pack overlaps: intersecting events → CSS-grid across equal columns.
- Memoize by `id + updatedAt`.
- Debounce drag paints to rAF (16ms).
- Prefetch adjacent week on idle so `]` is instant.

Source: [FullCalendar Virtualization Issue](https://github.com/fullcalendar/fullcalendar/issues/5673)

- **Drag state:** Original `opacity-30`. Ghost `opacity-70 ring-2 ring-electric-purple` at cursor. Time badge: `bg-ink-black text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded`.
- **Overlap:** Sort by start, greedy column-assign, render group as `grid-template-columns: repeat(N, 1fr)`.

- **Structure:** Sticky header (`sticky top-0 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-b`): weekday, date, "Today" pill. 48px left time rail + event column.
- **Events:** Full-width, 8px rounded, 3px left border artist color. Min-height 64px. Tap → bottom sheet (80vh).
- **Swipe:** CSS `scroll-snap-type: x mandatory` on horizontal day-strip; each day = snap stop.
- **FAB:** Bottom-right 56px circle, `bg-electric-purple shadow-card`, "+" → quick-add.
- **Empty day:** Centered icon + "No appointments" + "+ Add appointment" link.
